$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_landscape 0.1.0, registry/FS_landscape/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_landscape, by a validator that implements FS_landscape and knows it (spec.md 1.2). The core members of an element (fallback, host, clearances, option, name, extras) are checked by Floorspec Core, so this schema only names them. Geometry - a polygon's simplicity, a line's repeated points - is checked by the invariants (spec.md 3.4).
title: FS_landscape 0.1.0
description: Plants by species-agnostic size, planting beds, lawns and hardscape lines around a house.
